# City scenery pack (client/models/env/env_city.glb)

Rebuild: unzip the Kenney kits (City Kit Commercial 2.1, Nature Kit) to the paths at the top of build.mjs,
`npm i @gltf-transform/core@4 @gltf-transform/extensions@4 @gltf-transform/functions@4 meshoptimizer@0.21`, then `node build.mjs`.
The far-building texture (colormap_beirut.png) is the Kenney colormap with the same Beirut colour rules applied per pixel, 128 px.
